messages:
Alex H: Hey folks — can someone cover my overnight oncall tonight (10pm–6am PT)? partner's flight got moved and I need to pick up my kid from the airport. I can swap for Monday morning if needed.
Mira S: Sorry to hear that — can you share any risks to watch? there's a green deployment scheduled ~1am PT, right?
Alex H: Yep, green deployment to prod-models (canary) at 01:05 PT. I set a soft hold but ops said it will proceed unless oncall asks to pause. The bigger risk is the nightly quantize job that runs ~2:15am PT on dedicated pools in eu-west-1 — it's been restarting a node intermittently.
Jordan L: I can take that shift if still available. Quick Q: which dashboards should I watch and is there a short runbook?
Alex H: Awesome, thanks Jordan. Main things:
- Dashboards: Console -> Service Metrics -> "prod-inference" (latency P95 + errors), and "dedicated-eu-west" pool health.
- Alerts: PagerDuty rule "inference-p95" and "dedicated-pool-node-down".
- Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall-inference (see section "overnight - quantize job"), but quick commands below.
- Warm cache: I pre-warmed KV cache for top 5 routes; if you see cold starts, run `curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/prewarm -d '{"routes": ["/v1/generate", "/v1/chat"]}'`
- If quantize job OOMs and takes down a node: cordon + drain then restart job: `kubectl -n inference cordon <node>` then `kubectl rollout restart ds/quantize-worker`
Mira S: +1 to Jordan volunteering. Also ping me if you need a quick hand with the deployment pause.
DevOps Bot: Scheduled deployment: prod-models-canary will start at 2026-05-11T01:05:00-07:00. Initiator: release-bot. Estimated duration 8m.
Samir K: FYI — policy for green deployments: if oncall sees latency spike >20% for 3 consecutive mins during rollout, pause/rollback. The console button is "Pause rollout" on the release page.
Jordan L: Got it. Can you paste the minimal checklist? I might not be on my laptop during the airport pickup window.
Alex H: Minimal handoff checklist (doable from phone):
1) Watch P95 + errors on prod-inference and dedicated-eu-west.
2) If deployment starts and P95 jumps >20% for 3m, click Pause rollout and notify Mira/Samir.
3) If dedicated node restarts (alert fires), SSH to jumpbox -> `ssh jump@eu-west-1` then check `kubectl get nodes` and `kubectl describe node <name>`; if NotReady, cordon+drain as above and escalate.
4) Log any manual actions in the runbook page comments + Slack thread.
5) If you take a short break, set status and run `oncall-snooze 15m` in our bot.
Tia R: I can shadow the first hour remotely (10pm–11pm PT) to help with the deployment watch.
Jordan L: Thanks Tia — appreciated. I accept the shift. I'll set my PD schedule and message here when I'm live. :raised_hands:
Alex H: Thank you both — leaving a couple of extra notes:
- I left a prefetch cache dump at `s3://redwood-prefetch/lastdump-20260510.tar.gz` in case you need to restore.
- API key rotations: none scheduled, keys are valid.
- Contact list: Pager duty -> inference-oncall; backup -> samir.k@redwood.com; deploy rollback -> @mira_s.
Jordan L: I'm live on the shift now (22:03 PT). I've opened the dashboards and muted low-priority alerts.
DevOps Bot: Alert: nightly-quantize-job failed on node ip-10-11-12-34 (eu-west-1) at 02:16:37 PT — restart attempted.
Jordan L: Saw the alert. Looking into it now. If it degrades, I'll cordon and restart the daemonset as per checklist.
Samir K: If you run into repeated OOMs, add `--memory-guard=1g` to the quantize job args and re-deploy as temp mitigation (follow up with infra).
Jordan L: Applied temp mitigation and restarted, nodes stable. Leaving note in runbook.
Alex H: Perfect — really appreciate the coverage, Jordan. I'll repay the favor next week.
Mira S: Nice work. I'll follow up on infra ticket tomorrow to root cause the OOM.
Tia R: Great handoff flow. :thumbsup:
